title: A worker image without ticfac probes green, then dies with a misleading config/model error
body: After 46x the image scripts need ticfac, but worker.sh --probe (225-249) and the Dockerfile's green-start layer check only tk, git and the harness. A missing ticfac (exit 127) surfaces as EXIT_CONFIG 'TICKS_SUBSTRATE must be herdr, harness, auto or cloud' (entrypoint.sh:170-173) or EXIT_MODEL 'broken config' (common.sh:222-225), and toolchain provisioning and the image check are skipped silently. Add ticfac to the probe and a verify_ticfac check that names the real cause. This complements finding b87b1159, which is about installing ticfac in image/Dockerfile.
demonstrating_check: go test ./internal/sandboximage/ (a new case: entrypoint with ticfac absent from PATH)
